steps.title: Vite bundle
steps.description: Bundles .flow modules and virtual CSS into standard ESM for production.
steps.explanation: The FluxDOM Vite plugin compiles .flow Single File Components into direct DOM operations and extracts virtual scoped CSS modules. It transforms components ahead of time during Vite dev and build cycles, emitting standard ESM without runtime compiler overhead.
